questions.q: Server is down. How will you troubleshoot?
questions.a: 1. Check power and network. 2. Check if the server is reachable. 3. Check running services. 4. Check logs. 5. Check disk space, CPU, and memory. 6. Restart the failed service if needed. 7. Verify that the application is working.
